title: Core: AS2 bitwise operators (&, |, ^, <<, >>, >>>)
description: Test compilation of bitwise operators: a & b (ActionBitAnd 0x60), a | b (ActionBitOr 0x61), a ^ b (ActionBitXor 0x62), a << b (ActionBitLShift 0x69), a >> b (ActionBitRShift 0x6A), a >>> b (ActionBitURShift 0x6B), ~a (ActionBitXor 0x62 with -1). Test compound assignments: &=, |=, ^=, <<=, >>=, >>>=. Verify each correct opcode.
